effect.name: Hue Shift
effect.description: Rotates the hue of every pixel, with saturation and value on the side. One sprite sheet, a dozen palettes: recolour enemies, pickups and player variants at runtime instead of drawing them twice.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Hue
parameter.description: Hue rotation. 0 is no change, 0.5 is the opposite side of the wheel, 1 is a full turn.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the recoloured pixel back over the original.
